# Taut

> Slack in your terminal, for you and your agents: channels, threads,
> history, unread counts, and live following for participants who already
> share a machine. No server, no daemon, no config, no accounts — one
> SQLite file by default, Postgres through an extension. The core ships
> on PyPI as `taut-chat`; the command is `taut`.

Taut is built on SimpleBroker's durable queues; `.taut.db` is a standard
SimpleBroker database and the plumbing is deliberately not hidden. The
trust model is storage access: everyone who can write the storage is a
full participant, and identity claims identify rather than authenticate.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/README.md): the human
  product entry and, per section, the contract of record
- [Agent kernel](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/agent-kernel.md):
  agent-executable recipes — join, catch up, post, read as JSON, identity
  selection, DM handles, hazards, exit codes
- [Program theory](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/program-theory.md):
  what kind of system Taut is — durable principles, non-goals, and adopted
  design decisions with reconsider-when conditions
- [Product-section registry](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/specs/product-section-registry.md):
  the authority table naming the winning contract for each behavior family
- [Core spec](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/specs/02-taut-core.md):
  storage model, thread semantics, message envelope, read model,
  CLI/API/watcher surfaces, and trust model
- [Identity spec](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/specs/03-identity-addressing-notifications.md):
  stable member identity, mutable names, direct messages, and
  notification inboxes
- [Summon spec](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/specs/04-summon.md):
  hosting an existing agent harness as an ordinary workspace member
- [MCP spec](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/specs/05-taut-mcp.md):
  the connection-scoped MCP stdio adapter
- [Search spec](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/specs/06-search.md):
  cursor-neutral full-text search across SQLite and PostgreSQL
- [Persistence spec](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/docs/specs/08-persistence-io.md):
  actor-free composite workspace dump and load
- [Changelog](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  released behavior deltas

## Extensions

- [taut-pg](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/extensions/taut_pg/README.md):
  the same commands on a project-configured Postgres database
- [taut-summon](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/extensions/taut_summon/README.md):
  host an agent harness as an ordinary workspace member
- [taut-mcp](https://github.com/VanL/taut/blob/main/extensions/taut_mcp/README.md):
  expose Taut workspaces to MCP clients
